_comment: Curated model reference for this repo. Facts that can be read from a
downloaded model's own files (context window, architecture, tool parser,
on-disk size) are NOT stored here — llmctl reads those live. This holds
only what cannot be derived: labels, roles, quantization notes, sizes for
models not yet downloaded, and which hardware profile each suits.
Text models: verified against the HF API and, where cached, their own
GENERATIVE-MODELS.md for sources; they are listed here as reference and
are NOT servable by `llmctl start` (different runtimes).

mlx-community/Qwen3-Coder-Next-4bit.label: Qwen3-Coder-Next 80B-A3B
mlx-community/Qwen3-Coder-Next-4bit.notes: Hybrid attention: only 12/48 layers hold KV, so 24.6 KB/token. Best tool-call robustness (92.7% across 5 IDE/CLI environments). SWE-bench Verified 70.6-71.3.

mlx-community/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instru.label: Qwen3-Coder 30B-A3B
mlx-community/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instru.notes: 95-114 tok/s on a fresh server. All 48 layers hold KV (98 KB/token), so 4x the context cost of Qwen3-Coder-Next. SWE-bench ~51.

mlx-community/gpt-oss-120b-MXFP4-Q8.label: gpt-oss 120B
mlx-community/gpt-oss-120b-MXFP4-Q8.notes: NO TOOL CALLING: mlx-lm 0.31.3 has no harmony parser, and it fails silently (finish_reason=stop, raw syntax in content). Its published evals did run at this MXFP4 quantization, unlike every other model here. SWE-bench 62.4.

mlx-community/GLM-4.5-Air-4bit.label: GLM-4.5-Air 106B-A12B
mlx-community/GLM-4.5-Air-4bit.notes: glm47 tool parser verified. The replacement for gpt-oss-120b in the different-family slot.

mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-4bit.label: GLM-4.7-Flash
mlx-community/GLM-4.7-Flash-4bit.notes: Claims SWE-bench 59.2 and tau2-bench 79.5 at 16.9 GB. Multi-turn scores assume Preserved Thinking mode, which mlx-lm does not implement, so discount them.

mlx-community/Devstral-Small-2-24B-Instr.label: Devstral Small 2 24B
mlx-community/Devstral-Small-2-24B-Instr.notes: Claims SWE-bench 68.0% from a 24B dense model. Dense means no MoE routing variance. mistral tool parser.

mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit.label: Qwen2.5 3B
mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit.notes: Default for the 16 GB M2 target.

mlx-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B
mlx-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-.notes: Best small coder for a 16 GB machine.

fcreait/Qwen-Image-Edit-mflux.label: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (q8)
fcreait/Qwen-Image-Edit-mflux.notes: WARNING: the repo holds q3/q4/q5/q6/q8 side by side and totals 151 GB -- download only the q8/ subdir (37.47 GB) via allow_patterns. Prefer mflux-community/qwen-image-edit-2511-mflux-bf16 (Apache-2.0, 2511).

mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-.label: Qwen3-VL 30B-A3B
mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-.notes: Image understanding. Not servable by llmctl start.

mlx-community/MiniCPM-o-4_5-4bit.label: MiniCPM-o 4.5
mlx-community/MiniCPM-o-4_5-4bit.notes: Speech OUT as well as in. Apache-2.0. The cheap omni option.

mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.label: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.notes: Most-downloaded mlx-community model. Bigger STT buys little.

mlx-community/Kokoro-82M-bf16.label: Kokoro 82M
mlx-community/Kokoro-82M-bf16.notes: Near the quality ceiling for its task regardless of budget.

mlx-community/index-tts2-mlx.label: IndexTTS 2
mlx-community/index-tts2-mlx.notes: DOES NOT LOAD on mlx-audio 0.5.4: the repo ships config.yaml, and mlx_audio.utils.load_config requires config.json. mlx-audio does implement IndexTTS (tts/models/indextts), so this is a packaging mismatch in the repo, not missing support. Use mlx-community/IndexTTS-2-MLX, which ships config.json.

mlx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-8bit.label: Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B
mlx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-8bit.notes: Via mlx_vlm.server. Avoid mlx-embeddings + ModernBERT: issue #80 returns silent all-NaN vectors on mixed-length batches.

mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-6bit.label: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (VLM, 6-bit)
mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-6bit.notes: Largest comfortable VLM here: 100.12 GB measured resident. Hybrid attention (12/48 layers hold KV), verified: 24.0 KiB/token, 3.22 GB at 128k -- vs 188 KiB/token for Qwen3-VL-235B. Beats the 235B on every published vision benchmark while being smaller. Apache-2.0. Not pulled: same model as the 5-bit, +15 GB, and 100 GB resident leaves nothing alongside.

mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-5bit.label: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (VLM, 5-bit)
mlx-community/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-5bit.notes: The safer big VLM: 84.88 GB leaves room for KV and apps under the ~100 GiB practical ceiling.

mlx-community/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruc.label: Qwen3-Omni 30B-A3B (bf16, speech out)
mlx-community/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruc.notes: Text out only on mlx-vlm 0.7.1, despite shipping the audio path. Verified: 417 talker + 230 code2wav tensors are in the weights and the loaded module exposes .talker/.code2wav, but there is no generate_audio method, which is what mlx-vlm's capability gate requires. Responds to text+image in 13s. For speech out use Kokoro TTS.

mflux-community/ideogram-4-mflux-q8.label: Ideogram 4 (8-bit)
mflux-community/ideogram-4-mflux-q8.notes: Best measured text-to-image trade here: Elo 1011.97 in 34 s. Beats HunyuanImage-3.0 at generation (964.80) for a fraction of the memory and time. GATED (auto-approve): accept the licence on the model page before pulling.

mflux-community/krea-2-turbo-mflux-bf16.label: Krea 2 Turbo (bf16)
mflux-community/krea-2-turbo-mflux-bf16.notes: Largest-quality image gen that stays well under the ceiling. Krea-2-Turbo mapping is inferred, not confirmed by the source leaderboard.

mflux-community/qwen-image-edit-2511-mfl.label: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (bf16)
mflux-community/qwen-image-edit-2511-mfl.notes: Apache-2.0 editing at full precision. Prefer over HunyuanImage unless you need the top Elo, and note requantize.py only goes downward.

Anes1032/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-mlx-q8.label: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (8-bit)
Anes1032/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-mlx-q8.notes: Replaces mlx-community/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-mlx-q8, which 404s. ~5s of 832x480 in ~23 min.

mlx-community/ltx-2.5-mlx-q8.label: LTX 2.5 (8-bit)
mlx-community/ltx-2.5-mlx-q8.notes: Consumer is xocialize/ltx-2-mlx branch ltx-2.5, NOT dgrauet/ltx-2-mlx (LTX-2.3 only). The bf16 repo is 110 GB.

mlx-community/IndexTTS-2-MLX.label: IndexTTS 2 (voice cloning)
mlx-community/IndexTTS-2-MLX.notes: Ships config.json, unlike mlx-community/index-tts2-mlx. For voice cloning and emotion; Kokoro remains the default for plain TTS.
